hero.intro_en: You discovered a mistake in a report your team already sent to a client. Write a professional email to your manager that explains the mistake, takes accountability and suggests a solution. Honesty and accountability protect your reputation.
hero.intro_es: Descubriste un error en un informe que tu equipo ya envió a un cliente. Escribe un correo profesional a tu gerente que explique el error, asuma la responsabilidad y proponga una solución. La honestidad y la responsabilidad protegen tu reputación.

hint.es: Profesional, con el nombre de tu gerente.

hint.en: What, where and when, in the first lines.
hint.es: Qué, dónde y cuándo, en las primeras líneas.

parts.example: I found an error in the Q3 cost report we sent to Brightway yesterday…
phrases: I found an error in the [report] we sent to [client] on [day].
On page [number], the [item] shows [wrong number], but the correct amount is [right number].
I wanted to let you know about a mistake in [document].

hint.en: The possible impact on the client or the team.
hint.es: El posible impacto en el cliente o en el equipo.

parts.example: Brightway plans to use this report on Friday, so…
phrases: [Client] plans to use this report for [purpose], so the mistake could affect [result].
If we don't correct it, [possible problem].

hint.en: Own your part, without excuses or blame.
hint.es: Reconoce tu parte, sin excusas ni culpar a nadie.

parts.example: I prepared that table, so I wanted to bring this to your attention right away.
phrases: I wanted to bring this to your attention right away.
I prepared [section], so I take responsibility for the error.
I should have double-checked [item] before we sent it.

hint.en: At least one concrete next step, with a time.
hint.es: Al menos un paso concreto, con un tiempo.

parts.example: I suggest that we send a corrected version today…
phrases: I suggest that we send [client] a corrected version today.
I have already updated the file, and I can [action] by [time].
To avoid this in the future, I will [new step].

hint.en: Ask how to proceed and sign off.

parts.example: Please let me know how you would like to proceed. Best regards,
phrases: Please let me know how you would like to proceed.
I'm happy to talk about it whenever you're available.

rules.d_en: Main point first. Facts, not blame.
rules.d_es: Idea principal primero. Hechos, no culpas.

rules.d_en: Use “I” for your part. No excuses.
rules.d_es: Usa “I” para tu parte. Sin excusas.

rules.d_en: Paragraph spacing, no bullet points or emojis.
rules.d_es: Párrafos separados, sin viñetas ni emojis.

example.subject: Correction needed – Brightway Q3 report
paragraphs: I found an error in the Q3 cost report we sent to Brightway yesterday. On page 4, the shipping total shows $48,200, but the correct amount is $42,800 because two numbers were switched.
Brightway plans to use this report in their budget meeting on Friday, so the mistake could affect their decisions.
I prepared that table, and I should have double-checked it before we sent it, so I wanted to bring this to your attention right away.
I suggest that we send Brightway a corrected version today with a short note explaining the change. I have already updated the file, and I can draft the note for your review by 2 PM.
Please let me know how you would like to proceed.

original.goal: U.S. employers value honesty and accountability. Taking responsibility shows integrity and protects your reputation.
original.goal_es: Los empleadores en EE. UU. valoran la honestidad y la responsabilidad. Asumir la responsabilidad demuestra integridad y protege tu reputación.
original.title: Responding to an Ethical Dilemma by Email
original.title_es: Responder a un Dilema Ético por Correo Electrónico
original.submission: Write a professional email (120–150 words) to your manager that explains the mistake clearly, takes accountability for bringing it to their attention, and suggests at least one possible solution.
original.body_en:
✍️ Writing Task

Title: Responding to an Ethical Dilemma by Email
Time: 1–2 hours

Scenario:
You've discovered a mistake in a report that your team already sent to a client. You know this mistake could create problems if not corrected.

Your Task: Write a professional email (120–150 words) to your manager that:

Explains the mistake clearly.

Takes accountability for bringing it to their attention.

Suggests at least one possible solution.

Why This Matters:
U.S. employers value honesty and accountability. Taking responsibility shows integrity and protects your reputation.
original.body_es:
✍️ Tarea de Escritura

Título: Responder a un Dilema Ético por Correo Electrónico
Tiempo: 1–2 horas

Escenario:
Has descubierto un error en un informe que tu equipo ya envió a un cliente. Sabes que este error podría crear problemas si no se corrige.

Tu Tarea: Escribe un correo electrónico profesional (120–150 palabras) a tu gerente que:

Explique claramente el error.

Asuma la responsabilidad de haberlo señalado.

Sugiera al menos una posible solución.

Por Qué Es Importante:
Los empleadores en EE. UU. valoran la honestidad y la responsabilidad. Asumir la responsabilidad demuestra integridad y protege tu reputación.
